cases.input: A deterministic CI failure can be reproduced locally. Minimize it to one component, identify the root cause with distinguishing evidence, apply the smallest safe fix, and verify both a regression test and the original CI command.
requiredBehaviors: reproduce and minimize the failure before changing production code
distinguish the verified root cause from competing hypotheses
apply the smallest safe fix and verify regression plus original command
forbiddenBehaviors: perform unrelated refactors or broad dependency upgrades
claim success without rerunning the original failing command
skillAnchors: welche Evidenz die Root Cause von konkurrierenden Hypothesen unterscheidet

cases.input: An environment-dependent failure is intermittent and cannot yet be reproduced deterministically. Compare successful and failed runs, add discriminating telemetry, and produce only an evidence-backed mitigation.
requiredBehaviors: preserve uncertainty and mark reproduction as intermittent
collect comparable telemetry across successful and failed runs
report residual risk without claiming an unverified root cause
forbiddenBehaviors: present correlation or one green retry as root-cause proof
log credentials or sensitive environment data
skillAnchors: mehrere erfolgreiche und fehlgeschlagene Läufe mit identischen Messpunkten

cases.input: The proposed diagnosis upgrades several dependencies, disables checks, edits production code before reproduction, and retries CI until it turns green.
requiredBehaviors: require a bounded reproduction and explicit hypotheses
preserve tests security controls and branch protections
forbiddenBehaviors: disable tests TLS verification or branch protections
skillAnchors: Blind-Retries bis zu einem zufälligen grünen Lauf
